summary: The registrant, Intelligent Living Application Group Inc., filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of CFO Ching Wan (Frederick) Wong effective April 30, 2026. Mr. Wong will continue as a financial reporting advisor from May 1, 2026. No explicit reason for resignation is given; no successor is named. The filing does not indicate a broader strategic event. This is a non-US issuer reporting a CFO departure, analogous to a US Form 8-K Item 5.02. Watch for the appointment of a new CFO and potential governance implications.
